# Aveneg Technologies, LLC

> Software publisher building private, encrypted, offline desktop software for people who keep a careful record of something valuable. Its first and only product is Watch Vault Archive, an offline desktop application for cataloguing a watch collection. Records stay on the owner's own computer: no cloud, no account. This site is the company's corporate site; the product has its own site. Contact is by email only; there is no contact form and no phone number.

- Address: 8735 Dunwoody Place, Ste R, Atlanta, GA 30350, United States
- Commercial licensing and legal: legal@avenegtechnologies.com
- General inquiries: info@avenegtechnologies.com
